top_signals.title: Exxon Signals Knockout Refining Earnings as Diesel Prices Soar
top_signals.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. is the latest oil supermajor to signal soaring third-quarter refining profits as wars in the Persian Gulf and Russia crippled fuel-making facilities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasuries ‘Absolutely’ Still a Safe Haven, Says JPMorgan’s Misra
top_signals.summary: Priya Misra, Core Plus Bond ETF portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, says moves in the bond market are “overdone,” pricing in three interest-rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. Misra also says fixed income is a “really attractive asset class” to hedge the AI trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
